summary: Devcon 8 在孟买开幕，Vitalik 的开幕演讲把形式化验证、开源硬件、私密通信列为以太坊使命的一部分。隐私方向集中上线：Aztec Tierra（Alpha V6）发布，Privacy Pools v2 在 Devcon 期间推出。Binance 初步报告披露，攻击者控制签名服务后用 EIP-7702 授权建立委托，暂停提现无法让授权失效。ethresear.ch 讨论 nonce 和 nullifier 的存储成本。

items.title: Aztec：发布 Aztec Tierra（Alpha V6）
items.note: 21:01 宣布（@aztecnetwork 推文）。官方博客：修复此前版本已知漏洞（包括 V5 发现的严重问题），证明系统核心组件做了形式化验证；本地设备上客户端证明约 1 秒，比上一版快一倍；以太坊到 Aztec 的消息投递从平均约 2 分钟降到最快约 12 秒；网络有 3,000 多个验证者，没有特权查看密钥和中心化排序器。
items.title_en: Aztec: Aztec Tierra (Alpha V6) launches
items.note_en: Announced at 21:01 (@aztecnetwork post). According to the blog, it fixes known vulnerabilities from earlier versions (including a critical issue found in V5), and core components of the proof system are formally verified. Client-side proving on a local device takes about 1 second, twice as fast as the previous version. Message delivery from Ethereum to Aztec drops from about 2 minutes on average to as little as about 12 seconds. The network has more than 3,000 validators, with no privileged viewing keys and no centralized sequencer.

items.title: Binance：10 月 29 日安全事件初步调查
items.note: 21:33 发布。约 63.4 亿美元资产受影响，约 28.5 亿美元已冻结或拦截。攻击者先控制了内部钱包签名服务，在正常提现流程之外发起交易。之后用签名服务利用 EIP-7702：发出 50 笔签名交易操纵账户 nonce，建立恶意委托授权，让攻击者控制的合约获得热钱包的部分执行权。
items.title_en: Binance: preliminary investigation of the October 29 security incident
items.note_en: Published at 21:33. About $6.34 billion of assets were affected and about $2.85 billion has been frozen or intercepted. The attacker first took control of the internal wallet signing service and sent transactions outside the normal withdrawal flow. It then used the signing service to exploit EIP-7702: 50 signed transactions manipulated account nonces and set up a malicious delegation, giving an attacker-controlled contract partial execution rights over hot wallets.

items.topic: 重放保护与 nonce 的存储成本
items.title: ethresear.ch：存储优化的重放保护
items.note: 04:15 发布（作者 dlebee）。隐私池每次提款写一个 nullifier，Permit2 的 `nonceBitmap` 和 EIP-4337 式二维 nonce 要写重放标记，机器结算每个会话写一个标记。最常见的 `mapping(bytes32 => bool)` 每个标记约 22,100 gas（20,000 来自零到非零写入）。ZK 批处理让计算几乎免费，但这些标记无法压缩。文章比较打包标记位等做法，并问协议能否提供原生原语。
items.title_en: ethresear.ch: storage-optimized replay protection
items.note_en: Posted at 04:15 by dlebee. A privacy pool writes a nullifier on every withdrawal, Permit2's `nonceBitmap` and EIP-4337-style 2D nonces write replay flags, and machine settlement writes one flag per session. The most common `mapping(bytes32 => bool)` costs about 22,100 gas per flag (20,000 of it from the zero to non-zero write). ZK batching makes computation nearly free, but these flags cannot be compressed. The post compares packed flag lanes and other approaches and asks whether the protocol could provide a native primitive.
items.topic_en: Replay protection and the storage cost of nonces

summary_en: Devcon 8 opened in Mumbai, and Vitalik's opening talk placed formal verification, open hardware and private communication within Ethereum's mission. Privacy shipped in a cluster: Aztec Tierra (Alpha V6) launched and Privacy Pools v2 was released during Devcon. Binance's preliminary report says that once the attacker controlled its signing service, it set up delegation with EIP-7702 authorizations, and pausing withdrawals could not invalidate them. ethresear.ch looked at the storage cost of nonces and nullifiers.
